# Marva Herndon

# Board Director

![](/media/uploads/2026/07/marva-herndon.webp)

- Proposed a “Climate Equity” resolution [that would](https://web.archive.org/web/20250908070054/https:/www.tmj4.com/news/local-news/mps-school-board-directors-propose-climate-and-economic-equity-resolution) prepare students for future “green” jobs and cut district carbon emissions by 45% by 2030.
- “Climate justice acknowledges that climate change can have social, economic, public health and other adverse impacts on underprivileged populations,” said School Board Director Marva Herndon. “MPS wants to be an integral part in working towards climate justice to improve racial equity.”
- As part of the district’s “[Sustainability Action Plan](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/b85486c9-eb0b-45f7-ba85-02b0d8ff09bb/Milwaukee-PS-Sustainability-Action-Plan-Print-to-pdf.pdf)” supported by Herndon, the district will have school meals that are “culturally relevant” and “implement one meatless lunch per week.”
- The Sustainability Action Plan also creates a “Climate Education Coach” to lead a “K-12 curriculum audit” on “environmental literacy.” It also requires “all high school students to complete a career exploration activity that is connected to green careers.”
- Supported [the termination](https://restoration-news.com/getmedia/1348b1d5-27b8-4392-8788-f4547f576d88/Milwaukee-Herndon-SRO-meeting-minutes.pdf) of all contracts with the Milwaukee Police department for the services of School Resource Officers and other personnel.
